Lacking the organization and skill of other factions, Ratmen clans use their vast numbers and a variety of weapons to defeat their foes. As Ratmen emerged to their creators as sentient beings, they were greeted with fear and violence, and they were forced into a life of hiding and scavenging until they could flee their home world. Now that they finally found safety on secluded and abandoned worlds, where their numbers rapidly grew, they seek to help others even as many in Sirius still view them as vermin. Soon after their arrival in Sirius, the Conduit’s followers turned to genetic experimentation to adapt to the challenges of their new reality. [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/ratmen-clans) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Scurry: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2” when using Rush/Charge. ### Special Rules Defense Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Good Shot: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting. Hazardous: Gets AP(4), but this model's unit takes one wound on unmodified rolls of 1 to hit. Heavy Impact(X): Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1). No Retreat: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored. Quick Readjustment: This model ignores penalties from shooting after moving when using Indirect weapons. Ravage(X): When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Reinforcement: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken or fully destroyed, you may remove it from the table as destroyed and place a new copy of it fully within 12" of any table edge at the beginning of the next round after Ambushers have been deployed. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn’t apply to the new copy of the unit. Self-Destruct(X): If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits. Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Spawn(X): Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Takedown Shot: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make one extra attack against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown. Takedown Strike: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to attack in melee, it may make one attack at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown. Unpredictable Fighter: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Vanguard: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9” of its position. ### Aura Special Rules Ambush Aura: This model and its unit get Ambush. Evasive Aura: This model and its unit get Evasive. Melee Evasion Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Evasion. Piercing Assault Aura: This model and its unit get Piercing Assault. Precision Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls when shooting. Predator Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get Predator Shooter. Scurry Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Scurry Boost. Read more ### Spells Weapon Booster (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Scurry Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Focused Shock (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Shred. Tech-Sickness (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which get -1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply). System Takeover (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits. Enhance Serum (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply). Power Surge (3): Pick one enemy model within 12", which takes 6 hits with Hazardous. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 1" effects trigger.
